body.voice_description: Create an original gentle chess companion voice. A naturally low female alto with a soft contemporary Dublin Irish accent and warm grounded resonance. Friendly conversational intelligence, lightly textured consonants, relaxed confidence and small sincere changes of emphasis. Direct and reassuring without becoming a sleepy narrator. Keep the accent readable and the delivery natural. No goofy character affectation, high cartoon pitch, rubbery or nasal voice, vocal bouncing or exaggerated whimsy. Fluent English at a normal conversational teaching pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
body.text: Notice what changed. That piece lost its defender. The other side can take it now. Keep the idea simple: look after your pieces.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
